scope: Independent read-only review of four retained previews and one unallocated VALUES Rule; no native, code, test, or Git change.

reviews.evidence: Existing @13 Draft is byte-identical to its preview; cardinality bounds, occurrence/value/name distinctions, reverse slots, and omission semantics are unchanged.

FENCED_LABELS retains one label per fenced-block occurrence, duplicate and empty-label behavior, per-bearer scope, explicit count/Format handling, and error handling for missing/multiple/malformed/ambiguous inputs.

VALUES selects direct p values only; same-instance filters, left-to-right short-circuiting, evaluated-error behavior, current-Project snapshot, scalar requirement, ordering, empty/incomplete/incompatible/non-orderable errors, and MAX scalar tie behavior are retained.

VALUES(p) denotes actual direct value occurrences rather than allowed values or constraints; duplicates, known absence, malformed/unresolved errors, Format equality, and per-bearer scope are retained. COUNT(VALUES(p)) and COUNT(DISTINCT VALUES(p)) are canonical and unambiguous.

The new approved VALUES Rule adds only direct actual-value selection, excludes recursive and constraint-data traversal, preserves duplicate/absence/error semantics and applicable cardinality/Format, and allocates no ID.

non_changes_verified: UNIQUE and DETERMINES tuple fields remain their Current single-value-per-selected-instance/state constructs; no blind VALUES rewrite is introduced.
No parser implementation or executable function beyond the approved unallocated VALUES construct is proposed.
limitations: VALUES is source-only and unallocated; parser implementation and coordinated native adoption remain later work.
